title: Fruit — Consequence, Output, Externality and Future Seed
status: project-native operator deepening + pragmatic evaluation context
purpose: Turn Fruit from a general success symbol into a domain-aware consequence contract usable across practice, research, culture, Works, biology and world systems.
epistemic_rule: Fruit is project interpretation. Practical consequences can test usefulness, capability and side effects, but consequence alone does not establish metaphysical or factual truth.
core_definition: Fruit is the downstream output of a process whose quality can be evaluated. Good-looking output is not enough: Fruit includes intended effects, unintended effects, beneficiaries, costs, persistence and whether future independent Seed/capacity is created.

required_questions: Who receives benefit, burden or risk?
Over what timescale should effects be evaluated?
Which observable indicators would show improvement or harm?
What externalities fall outside the producer's preferred metric?
Is the effect reversible or repairable?
Does the result create future independent capacity/Seed or ongoing dependency?
What evidence would make us downgrade the claimed Fruit?

fruit_types.meaning: directly supports life/capability or reduces fragility
creates transferable future Seed, skill, knowledge or productive capacity
reduces accumulated damage or restores viable relation/capability
improves orientation, provenance, prediction or correction
produces art/work that carries meaning or opens new possibility
changes rules/capabilities so future participants can function better
appears productive locally while shifting hidden costs, dependency or damage elsewhere
produces visible output but no future capacity, learning or repeatable value

domain_examples.biology: growth, resilience, viable propagules, health/function — evaluated biologically
domain_examples.research: better model, resolved uncertainty, reproducible result, negative result that prevents error
domain_examples.culture: greater correction, reciprocity, role plasticity, meaningful exit and independent capacity
domain_examples.works: finished creative artifact plus reception/learning without pretending popularity proves truth
domain_examples.world_systems: measurable capability, resilience, rights, service quality or economic/infrastructural outcomes
domain_examples.practice: changed conduct, repaired relation, improved judgment or reduced repeated harm

metric_failure.rule: A single metric can become a false Fruit when optimization improves the number while degrading the underlying goal.

relation_to_cycle.key_rule: Fruit closes the loop only when some output can responsibly become future Seed without hiding accumulated cost.

philosophical_context.note: Pragmatist traditions emphasize practical bearings, inquiry and consequences in clarifying concepts. The project borrows the discipline of asking what difference a claim/process makes while keeping truth, usefulness and moral value distinct.
